title: Knowledge Evaluation Dataset
description: Ground-truth question set used to measure Knowledge search quality (04-knowledge-platform.md §4.3). 평가 질문은 업무 전문가가 검토한다 — 생성형 AI가 만든 질문은 사람 검토 없이 기준 데이터로 사용하지 않는다(§4.3). review_status가 EXPERT_REVIEWED가 아닌 데이터셋은 참고용으로만 취급해야 한다.

dataset_id.description: Stable dataset identifier used by version comparison (§4.6) to confirm two evaluation runs used the same dataset

version.description: SemVer of the dataset content itself; bump when cases are added/edited

knowledge_asset_id.description: The Knowledge Asset (not AssetVersion) this dataset provides ground truth for — expected to stay valid across versions of the same Knowledge

review_status.description: AI_GENERATED_UNREVIEWED: questions/expected answers were drafted by a generative AI and have NOT been checked by a domain expert — per §4.3 this must never be treated as an approved quality baseline. EXPERT_REVIEWED: a named reviewer has confirmed the cases.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewer identity; required (non-null) when review_status is EXPERT_REVIEWED

expected_document_ids.description: Document ids this question should retrieve. Matched against the search-runtime citation's document_path/document_title filename stem, lower-cased (see docs/implementation-spec/open-decisions.md D-045) — an empty array means this question is expected to have no correct document (used for no-result / distractor cases).

expected_chunk_ids.description: Optional stronger ground truth: exact chunk_id(s) that should be cited. Informational in this evaluator (chunk-level hit is reported per-case but is not part of the required aggregate metrics).

required_filters.description: metadata_filters sent to search-runtime for this case

forbidden_document_ids.description: Document ids that must never appear in the result set for this question (e.g. superseded/out-of-scope policy documents)
